senses.gloss:
śivá,
 —1. a. kind, 90^2; friendly; gracious;
agreeable, lovely; opp. of ghora;
 —2. m.
The Friendly One, name euphemistically
applied to the horrible god Rudra, who
under this name (Śiva) becomes the third
person of the Hindu Trinity. [for mg 2,
cf. Εὐμενίδες, ‘The Gracious Ones, i. e. the
Furies,’ and nandi.]

√sīv (sī́vyati; syūtá; -sī́vya). sew.
[prop. sīū (765): cf. √sā, si, ‘bind,’ sū́tra,
‘thread,’ sūcī́, ‘needle’: cf. κασ-σύω,
*κατα-σύω, ‘sew down, stitch together,
cobble’; Lat. su-ere, ‘sew,’ sū-tor, ‘shoemaker’;
 AS. siw-ian, seowian, Eng. sew;
AS. seām, Eng. seam, Ger. Saum, ‘hem,
border.’]
